The structure of Li8Ti4Bi4O24 (reduced formula Li2TiBiO6) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 40 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Ti each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Li adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. Corner-sharing between BiO6 and TiO6 octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Li 12-vertex polyhedra and the octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
